title: What Happens If the CIA Turns a Cat Into a Spy?
description:
In the 1960s, the CIA hid a microphone, a transmitter and an antenna inside a cat to spy on the Soviets.
Its first mission was two men on a park bench in Washington. The cat had other plans.

Sources: Wikipedia ("Acoustic Kitty", citing the declassified CIA memo released in 2001); History.com; Mental Floss; WETA Boundary Stones; HowStuffWorks
